filePkgPathUrl.description:
The package path url in the server. This is provided to help pick up the correct file metric
results from the code analyzer, which are key-ed by the file's url in the server.

The server removes paths up to the package's directory when storing files, i.e.,
a file with path 'repo/apps/myPackage/src/MyType.c3typ' in the source control repository would be stored as
'meta://myPackage/src/MyType.c3typ' in the filesystem, omitting the 'repo/apps' packages path.

filePathInSourceControlRepo.description: The path of the file for which the diff is being parsed in the source control repository.

added.description: The map of the added line number to the added line content (the added part of the diff).

deleted.description: The map of the deleted line number to the deleted line content (the modified part of the diff).

unchangedLineMap.description:
The map from the unchanged line in the new version of the file to the previous version of the file.
Since the code analyzer only has access to the new version of the file, this can be used to perform operations
on deleted lines which reference line numbers in the previous version of the file.

title:
Type to store file diffs. Includes the {@link #deleted} map which maps the line number of the original file
to the pre-modified content and the {@link #added} map which maps the line number of the new file to the
newly added content.
name: BaseCodeAnalyzer.SourceControlGadget.FileDiff
